title: [SEP-5] `pushUrgency` in the outer envelope marks DMs and mentions in the clear
description: Review finding SEP-5: `pushUrgency` in the outer envelope marks DMs and mentions in the clear (lens SEP). Location: spec/11-transport.md:233-239; vs spec/04-access-control.md:145 ("relays cannot distinguish DM traffic from channel traffic"), spec/12-security.md:48. Fix: Remove `pushUrgency` from the RoutingEnvelope. Without depending on SEP-4, the recipient can give a per-token urgency in its relay registration, changing `channelTokens` to `[{token, urgency}]`. This keeps message kind off every envelope and stops senders from forcing high-priority wakes. Full text: notes/review/SEP-verified.md and notes/review/SEP.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: pushUrgency removed from RoutingEnvelope (spec/05-messaging.md §5.2.2 CDDL); spec/11-transport.md §11.7.4 wake-ups carry no content and no urgency; spec/10-relays.md §10.4.3; spec/12-security.md Wake-ups
